title: ephedra distachya subvar. monostachya
intro: Ephedra distachya subvar. monostachya, commonly known as Ma Huang, is a plant species in the Ephedraceae family, native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, providing various health benefits, including relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis, asthma, and allergies, due to its decongestant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ephedra distachya subvar. monostachya include stimulating the heart, increasing circulation, and reducing fatigue. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
